raw_reply: SELECT R.NAME, R.FOOD_TYPE, R.RATING FROM RESTAURANT R JOIN GEOGRAPHIC G ON R.CITY_NAME = G.CITY_NAME WHERE G.REGION = 'Bay Area' ORDER BY R.RATING DESC LIMIT 5
